name: Quick Chat
afterHooks: cd $RELEASE_PATH && sed -i 's/DB_HOST=mysql/DB_HOST=chat-app-prod-mysql/g' .env && docker compose -p chat-app -f compose.prod.yaml up -d --remove-orphans --build && echo 'Waiting 30s for DNS stabilization...' && sleep 30 && docker exec chat-app-prod-php php artisan config:clear && docker exec chat-app-prod-php php artisan migrate --force
